admission.justification: Two uncalled delivery implementations beside the one the tool calls can diverge and lose or repeat a message; removing the duplicate leaves one send path, and the whole test tree still collects.

applicability: The role-message delivery module and the tests that reached only its uncalled copy.
conditions: The shared file, attachment, store, link, successor and long-reply helpers stay.
exclusions: The uncalled duplicate delivery path and its own tests are removed; the whole test tree still collects.

evidence: python -m pytest -m "" --collect-only -q mcp/tests -> 6191 tests collected, exit 0; ruff check over mcp/src and mcp/tests clean on the smaller module (1064 -> 636 lines); report role-reports/worker/8500ba4e-39b3-5373-8e2d-cfe91a38af4c/role-launch/260928-MIK-L171-worker-8500ba4e-39b3-5373-8e2d-cfe91a38af4c.md

statement: One message has one send path: the module that files a message no longer carries a second, uncalled delivery implementation beside the one the tool calls.
